exam_scheme.note: Conducted as a single-stage online Computer Based Test (CBT) across multiple shifts by TCS iON on behalf of the Revenue and Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra. The examination comprises 100 multiple choice objective questions carrying 2 marks each, for a total of 200 marks over a duration of 120 minutes (2 hours). There is no negative marking. Under official examination rules, candidates must score at least 45% marks (90 out of 200) to qualify for consideration in the category-wise and district-wise selection list.

financial_package.note: Talathi is a Group C post under the Revenue Department, Government of Maharashtra, governed by the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019. Pay scale is strictly distinct from Central 7th CPC.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level S-8 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27% based on posting classification: ₹2,295 to ₹6,885), village traveling/saza allowance, net of National Pension System (10% basic + DA = ₹4,029), profession tax (₹200), and state insurance deductions.
